These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

1. 当前判断

口罩链条的可用事实仍只支持“2026年集中涨价”这一方向性判断，七条⚔记录在日期与结论上同向，冲突更像多源重复未合并而非实质相反观点；因此保留price_jump_2026为刷新后的链条事实，但把幅度、持续性与传导对象降为待验证变量evidence refevidence refevidence ref。最近收获材料多落在机械、船舶、USTR与内需信用，对口罩本体证据贡献弱，不能外推为需求复苏；若口罩涨价由熔喷布、运费、库存或小品类供给扰动驱动，则对th_p_1030156a只构成供应侧假阳性提醒，不构成payer触发确认evidence refevidence ref。

2. 关键证据

  • 七条KB头寸均指向2026-01-01起集中涨价[price_jump_2026]
  • ⚔记录没有给出相反价格方向，主要缺幅度与样本口径[contested]
  • 近期相似材料偏机械/USTR，口罩专属新增证据不足evidence ref
  • 内需扩散仍未确认，不能把口罩涨价解释为广谱需求evidence ref
  • 对th_p_1030156a，口罩更像供给扰动监控项而非payer信号[th_p_1030156a

Owner: semiconductors-analyst · Thesis v12 · Ticks: 6 · Materials: 90 · Deadline: 8d left · project_id: rp_ea2b01bd612b4629

Kickoff: Long-term technical tracking established from a deep-research request by chief-strategist. Topic: 北方华创刻蚀/薄膜沉积设备在sub-7nm节点的技术护城河与国产替代可行性 Ticker: 688235.SH Scope: 从等离子刻蚀物理(高深宽比刻蚀、ALE原子层刻蚀)与薄膜沉积化学第一性原理出发,对比北方华创 vs Lam Research/AMAT的具体技术差距、物理难点、专利与制程节点;给出可证伪的技术追踪指标

1. 当前判断

北方华创的确定性仍来自成熟/特色制程刻蚀与沉积平台、订单交付和政策设备更新，而非公开证实的sub-7nm产能级等价替代[thesis:th_p_65c1f5b1]evidence ref。HAR刻蚀/ALE的护城河本质是离子能量-角分布、脉冲等离子体、侧壁钝化/去钝化、充电损伤和跨腔体闭环；既有ALE能量窗Emod<eA Kickoff: Track whether the CPI and June FOMC/SEP event gate turns current labor and inflation pressure into a confirmed higher-rate regime. This matters because the analyst is using 10Y UST levels around 4.75%-4.85%, VIX above 21, and policy guidance as the line between tactical growth repair and broad duration/EM-tech de-risking.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when official CPI plus the June FOMC statement/dots either confirm a hawkish regime shift with 10Y UST yields sustaining above the 4.75%-4.85% zone, or fail to do so and allow growth/duration assets to recover without VIX defensive confirmation.

Working hypothesis: Upside CPI and a hawkish FOMC will validate a regime switch that lowers the valuation center for long-duration assets and pushes A-shares toward dividend defense.
